title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: border
text:
border
border
(definition)
Definition:
A
string
v which is both a
prefix
and a
suffix
of another string u.  String v is the border of u if it is the longest
proper
border of u.
Note:
From Algorithms and Theory of Computation Handbook, page 11-26, Copyright © 1999 by CRC Press LLC. Appearing in the Dictionary of Computer Science, Engineering and Technology, Copyright © 2000 CRC Press LLC.
